S.FORM: hngawan ryax sawn maha hngawan ryax hya' ga, sni' na squliq maha phngaw kwara' qu Tayal ini' ptzyuwaw na qmayah maha qu kay' qani hya'. hngwan ryax qani hya' iy sraral hya' ga, bali maki' qu hngawan na Tayal hya', a nanak yaqu mczngsuy ghzyaq qu kayal qani ka maymaw balay ini' qbaq mtzyuwaw qu hngawan ryax naha' qani. babaw niya' lga, mwah lqu Thayluw lga, 'naras naha' kya lqu gaga' na musa' Rihay Kyokay hya' la. babaw niya' lawzi lga, nanu' yaqu mhngaw na pqwasan biru' na Laylaqi' ka sawn maha hngawal 'bagan squ hngawan qmisan qani, iy hngawan na qmisan hya' ga mutuw qutux balay Byacing, ga hngawan 'bagan hya' ga mutuw sazing Bycing kin bsiyaq ryax na hngawan naha' qani hya'. qutux lawzi qu sawn mutuw naha' shngaw ryax hya' ga, nanu' yaqu mhngaw na pinsmyan na plmukan qani, mucing sqani qu baqun maku' zyuwaw na sawn maha hngawan ta' qani.
S.PHON: ħŋawan rjax [s|ɕ]awn maħa ħŋawan rjax ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]niʔ na [s|ɕ]quliq maħa pħŋaw kwaraʔ qu tajal iniʔ ptzjuwaw na qmajaħ maħa qu kajʔ qani ħjaʔ ħŋwan rjax qani ħjaʔ ij [s|ɕ]raral ħjaʔ ɣa βali makiʔ qu ħŋawan na tajal ħjaʔ a nanak jaqu m[ʦ|ʨ]zŋ[s|ɕ]uj ɣħzjaq qu kajal qani ka majmaw βalaj iniʔ qβaq mtzjuwaw qu ħŋawan rjax naħaʔ qani βaβaw nijaʔ lɣa mwaħ lqu tħajluw lɣa ʔnara[s|ɕ] naħaʔ kja lqu ɣaɣaʔ na mu[s|ɕ]aʔ riħaj kjokaj ħjaʔ la βaβaw nijaʔ lawzi lɣa nanuʔ jaqu mħŋaw na pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiruʔ na lajlaqiʔ ka [s|ɕ]awn maħa ħŋawal ʔβaɣan [s|ɕ]qu ħŋawan qmi[s|ɕ]an qani ij ħŋawan na qmi[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa mutuw qutux βalaj βja[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ ɣa ħŋawan ʔβaɣan ħjaʔ ɣa mutuw [s|ɕ]aziŋ βj[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ kin β[s|ɕ]ijaq rjax na ħŋawan naħaʔ qani ħjaʔ qutux lawzi qu [s|ɕ]awn mutuw naħaʔ [s|ɕ]ħŋaw rjax ħjaʔ ɣa nanuʔ jaqu mħŋaw na pin[s|ɕ]mjan na plmukan qani mu[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ [s|ɕ]qani qu βaqun makuʔ zjuwaw na [s|ɕ]awn maħa ħŋawan taʔ qani
